cards.t: Why we test programs: test data
cards.tz: 为什么要测试程序：测试数据
cards.en:
Think of a new recipe: you taste it before serving guests. Testing a program is the same: you try it with chosen inputs before users rely on it.

Test data = inputs we choose on purpose to check a program.

  • Run the program with each test datum.
  • Write down the test result (what it really outputs).
  • Compare it with the expected result (what it should output).
  • Different results = an error in the program.

Three kinds of test data: normal, erroneous, boundary.

A test plan is a table:

Test dataTypeExpected resultTest result

Valid data alone is not enough. After valid data, continue to test with invalid data.

Exam wording: Test data is used to check whether the program produces the expected results. If the test result is different from the expected result, there is an error.

Career box: a game tester plays a game again and again to check smoothness, performance and vulnerabilities (also culture, balance and plot testing), e.g. tapping keys repeatedly or cutting the power to the server.
cards.zh:
就像做新菜，上桌前先试味道。测试程序也一样：先用挑选好的输入试运行，再交给用户。

Test data（测试数据）= 刻意挑选、用来检查程序的输入。

  • 用每个测试数据运行程序。
  • 记下 test result（测试结果），即实际输出。
  • 和 expected result（预期结果）比较。
  • 两者不同 = 程序有错。

三类：normal、erroneous、boundary。

测试计划是表格：

测试数据类型预期结果测试结果

只测有效数据不够，之后要继续测无效数据（Checkpoint 6.1 Q1）。

考试写法：Test data is used to check whether the program produces the expected results. If the test result is different from the expected result, there is an error.

职业框：game tester（游戏测试员）反复玩游戏，检查流畅度、性能和漏洞（还有文化、平衡、剧情测试），例如不停按键或切断服务器电源。

ex.q: Anson has tested his algorithm with some valid data items. What should he do next?
ex.a: Continue to test the algorithm with invalid (erroneous) data items, and boundary values, to check that the program handles them correctly. Flowcharts, documentation or modular redesign do not test the program.
ex.az: 下一步应该用无效数据继续测试，看程序能否正确处理错误输入。

ex.q: Write a test table row for a program that doubles a number, input 7.
ex.a:
1. Test data: 7.
2. Type: normal.
3. Expected result: 14.
4. Run it, write the test result. If it shows 14, the test passes.
ex.az: 1. 测试数据 7；2. 正常数据；3. 预期 14；4. 运行后记录测试结果，是 14 就通过。

ex.q: A student says: 'My program worked for 5 and 10, so it has no errors.' Is this right?
ex.a:
1. No. Two normal values only test some paths.
2. Testing can show errors exist, not prove there are none.
3. He must also try erroneous and boundary values (e.g. 0, -1, the range edges).
ex.az: 1. 不对，两个正常值只测了部分路径；2. 测试只能证明有错，不能证明没错；3. 还要测错误值和边界值。

notes.t: each row: test data and expected result
notes.tz: 每行：测试数据和预期结果

notes.t: run the program to get the test result
compare test result with expected result
notes.tz: 比较测试结果和预期结果

cards.en:
Normal data is everyday input, the kind a real user types. Like checking each road of a junction, you need one value for every branch.

Normal data values = data inside the valid range that the program is meant to handle.

  • You need enough of them to run every branch of each if / else if.
  • 4 valid branches → at least 4 normal values, one each.
  • A branch never run during testing can hide an error.

Exam wording: Normal data values are within the valid range and should be adequate to test all branches of the selection structures.
cards.zh:
正常数据就是用户平常会输入的值。像检查路口的每条路，每个分支都要有一个值走过。

Normal data values（正常数据值）= 有效范围内、程序预期会处理的数据。

  • 数量要足够走过每个 if / else if 的每个分支。
  • 4 个有效分支 → 至少 4 个正常值。
  • 测试时没执行过的分支，错误就藏在里面。

考试写法：Normal data values are within the valid range and should be adequate to test all branches of the selection structures.

ex.q: Guessing game: SecretNumber = 25, valid range 1 to 100. Branch 1 outputs 'too small' (Guess < 25), Branch 2 'too big' (Guess > 25). Give normal test data.
ex.a: Need one value for each branch plus the exit: e.g. 20 (any 1 to 24) tests branch 1, 50 (any 26 to 100) tests branch 2, and 25 tests the exit from the loop ('Bingo!').
ex.az: 每个分支各一个：20 测“太小”，50 测“太大”，25 测退出循环。

ex.q: Program: mark 0-100; mark >= 50 Pass, else Fail. Give normal test data.
ex.a:
1. Valid range is 0 to 100.
2. Branch Pass needs a value like 70.
3. Branch Fail needs a value like 30.
4. Normal data: 30 and 70.
ex.az: 有效范围 0-100；Pass 分支用 70，Fail 分支用 30。

ex.q: For the same program a student chooses normal data 60, 70, 80. What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. All three go to the Pass branch.
2. The Fail branch is never run, so a bug there stays hidden.
3. Fix: include one value below 50, e.g. 30.
ex.az: 三个值都走 Pass 分支，Fail 分支没有测到；要加一个低于 50 的值。

cards.en:
Users make mistakes: typing letters for numbers or impossible dates. Erroneous data checks the program says 'no' politely instead of crashing.

Erroneous data values = invalid inputs.

  • Purpose: check the program handles invalid input (shows an error message, does not crash or give a wrong answer).
  • They are outside the valid range or the wrong form.

Examples:

  • negative age
  • month 13
  • check-out date before check-in date
  • 31 September (date that does not exist)

Write an expected result for them too, e.g. The range is 1 to 100!

Exam wording: Erroneous data values are invalid inputs used to test whether the program can handle invalid inputs (e.g. show an error message).
cards.zh:
用户会打错，例如输入不存在的日期。错误数据用来检查程序会礼貌地拒绝，而不是崩溃。

Erroneous data values（错误数据值）= 无效输入。

  • 目的：检查程序能处理无效输入（显示错误信息，不崩溃、不出错答案）。
  • 在有效范围外或格式不对。

例子：负数年龄、13 月、退房早于入住、9 月 31 日。

测试表也要写预期结果，如 The range is 1 to 100!

考试写法：Erroneous data values are invalid inputs used to test whether the program can handle invalid inputs.

ex.q: A hotel site offers rooms from 1-10-2022 to 1-12-2022. Drop-down lists allow day 1-31, month 1-12, year 2022-2024. Give three kinds of erroneous input.
ex.a:
1. Date with no accommodation: check in 18/9/2022 (before 1-10-2022).
2. Illogical range: check in 1/12/2022, check out 28/11/2022 (check-out earlier than check-in).
3. Non-existent date: check in 31/9/2023 (September has no 31st).
ex.az: 三种错误：不提供住宿的日期、退房早于入住、不存在的日期。

ex.q: Age must be 0 to 120. Give two erroneous values and expected results.
ex.a:
1. Below range: -5 → 'Invalid age'.
2. Above range: 150 → 'Invalid age'.
ex.az: 低于范围 -5、高于范围 150，预期都输出错误信息。

ex.q: A tester uses 200 as erroneous data and writes expected result 'program crashes'. Correct?
ex.a:
1. No. The expected result is what the program should do.
2. It should show an error message, e.g. 'The range is 1 to 100!'.
3. A crash means the test failed.
ex.az: 不对。预期结果写程序应有的表现（显示错误信息），崩溃代表测试失败。

cards.tz: 边界数据值 / 边际个案
cards.en:
Bugs like to hide at the edges, like a fence post: is the post itself inside or outside? Boundary data tests exactly at the edge and one step either side.

Boundary data values (boundary cases) = extreme values at a dividing line:

  • the value between normal and erroneous ranges, and values next to it;
  • the value where a condition changes from True to False, and values next to it.

Why: mistakes like < instead of <= only show at the edge.

Method (integers): for each dividing value v, test v-1, v, v+1.

Range 1-100Kinds
1normal + boundary
0, 101erroneous + boundary

Exam wording: Boundary data values are the dividing values between normal and erroneous data, and values close to them (v-1, v, v+1).
cards.zh:
错误最喜欢藏在边上，就像篱笆柱：柱子本身算里面还是外面？边界数据就是测边上那个值及左右各一步。

Boundary data values / boundary cases（边界数据值）= 分界线上的极端值：

  • 正常和错误范围之间的分界值及附近值；
  • 令条件由真变假的分界值及附近值。

原因：把 <= 写成 < 这类错误只在边上出现。

方法（整数）：每个分界值 v 测 v-1、v、v+1。

范围 1-100类型
1正常 + 边界
0、101错误 + 边界

考试写法：Boundary data values are the dividing values between normal and erroneous data, and values close to them.

ex.q:
Input number
if number < 0 then
    Output "Negative"
else
    Output "Non-negative"
List the boundary values.
ex.a: The dividing value is 0, so boundary values are -1, 0, 1. -1 is erroneous+boundary (Negative), 0 is boundary (Non-negative), 1 is normal+boundary (Non-negative). Add e.g. -5 (erroneous) and 20 (normal).
ex.az: 分界值是 0，所以边界值是 -1、0、1。

ex.q: Valid range 1 to 100. List the boundary values.
ex.a:
1. Lower dividing value 1 → test 0, 1, 2.
2. Upper dividing value 100 → test 99, 100, 101.
3. Boundary set: 0, 1, 2, 99, 100, 101.

ex.q: Code says if mark > 50: Pass but 50 should pass. Which test finds it, and is 'test 49 and 51' enough?
ex.a:
1. Only 50 shows the bug: expected Pass, got Fail.
2. 49 and 51 give correct results, so they miss it.
3. Always include the dividing value itself.
ex.az: 只有 50 才会暴露错误；只测 49 和 51 不够，一定要测分界值本身。

notes.t: test the boundary v-1, v, v+1
notes.tz: 测试边界 v-1, v, v+1

cards.t: Designing a full test table (guessing game)
cards.tz: 设计完整测试表（猜数字游戏）
cards.en:
A full test table is like a checklist before a flight: every switch is tested once. Each value has a reason to be there.

Guessing game: range 1 to 100, secret 25. The test data must cover:

  • erroneous values on both sides: -10, 200
  • boundaries of the range: 0, 1, 2, 99, 100, 101
  • boundaries around the secret: 24, 25, 26
  • a normal value for each branch: 20, 50
  • the value that exits the loop: 25

Full list: -10, 0, 1, 2, 20, 24, 25, 26, 50, 99, 100, 101, 200.

Each row gives the type and expected result. Say why you chose it, e.g. “100 is a boundary value between normal and erroneous data”.

Exam wording: for each value state the type of test data (normal / erroneous / boundary) and the expected result, and why it is chosen.
cards.zh:
完整测试表像起飞前的检查清单：每个开关都要测一次，每个值都有它存在的理由。

猜数字：范围 1-100，答案 25。测试数据要包括：

  • 两边的错误值：-10、200
  • 范围边界：0、1、2、99、100、101
  • 答案附近边界：24、25、26
  • 每个分支的正常值：20、50
  • 结束循环的值：25

完整：-10, 0, 1, 2, 20, 24, 25, 26, 50, 99, 100, 101, 200。

每行写类型和预期结果，并说明为什么选它。

考试写法：每个值写出数据类型（normal / erroneous / boundary）和预期结果，以及选它的原因。

ex.q: Give the expected result for 0, 24, 25, 26, 101 in the guessing game.
ex.a:
0: erroneous+boundary, 'The range is 1 to 100!'
24: boundary, 'The number is too small!'
25: boundary, exits loop, 'Bingo!'
26: boundary, 'The number is too big!'
101: erroneous+boundary, 'The range is 1 to 100!'
ex.az: 按条件逐个判断：0 和 101 超出范围，24 太小，25 猜中，26 太大。

ex.q: Run the guessing game with inputs 0, 24, 26, 25. What is printed?
ex.a:
1. 0 → 'The range is 1 to 100!'
2. 24 → 'The number is too small!'
3. 26 → 'The number is too big!'
4. 25 → 'Bingo!' and the loop ends.
ex.az: 0 超范围；24 太小；26 太大；25 猜中并结束。

ex.q: A test table for the game lists only 20, 50, 25. What is missing?
ex.a:
1. No erroneous data (e.g. -10, 200).
2. No boundary values at 1/100 (0, 1, 100, 101) or around 25 (24, 26).
3. Only normal values, so range-check bugs stay hidden.
ex.az: 缺少错误值和边界值，只测正常值，范围检查的错误发现不了。

code.out:
The range is 1 to 100!
The number is too small!
The number is too big!
Bingo!

cards.t: Test data for a BMI algorithm (Example 6.1)
cards.tz: BMI 算法的测试数据（例 6.1）
cards.en:
A number line is like a map of zones. Put a pin in every zone and on every border, and you will see every output at least once.

When ranges map to outputs, draw a number line and mark every dividing value: 0, 18.5, 23, 25.

ConditionOutputTest
bmi <= 0Error-5
< 18.5Underweight15
< 23Normal20
< 25Overweight24
elseObese30

Watch < vs <=:

  • 18.5 → Normal
  • 23 → Overweight
  • 25 → Obese

Add these dividing values as boundary tests to catch wrong signs.

Exam wording: choose at least one test value in each range so that every output is produced, plus the boundary values 0, 18.5, 23, 25.
cards.zh:
数轴像一张分区地图：每个区插一根针，每条边界也插一根，就能看到每种输出。

范围对应不同输出时，画数轴标出分界值：0、18.5、23、25。

条件输出测试
bmi <= 0Error-5
< 18.5Underweight15
< 23Normal20
< 25Overweight24
elseObese30

注意 < 与 <=：18.5 → Normal；23 → Overweight；25 → Obese。把分界值也加入测试，可找出符号写错。

考试写法：每个区间至少选一个值，令每种输出都出现，再加上边界值 0、18.5、23、25。

ex.q: Which output should bmi = 23 give, and why is it a good test?
ex.a: 23 is not < 23, but is < 25, so the output is Overweight. It is a boundary value: if the programmer wrote <= by mistake, it would wrongly print Normal.
ex.az: 23 不小于 23 但小于 25，输出 Overweight。它是边界值，可检查 < / <= 写错。

ex.q: What does bmi = 18.5 output?
ex.az: 逐个判断，18.5 < 23 成立，输出 Normal。

ex.q: A student says 25 is 'Overweight' because 25 is the top of that range. Correct?
ex.a:
1. Check: 25 < 25 is False.
2. So it falls to else → Obese.
3. The mistake is reading < as <=.
ex.az: 25 < 25 不成立，所以是 Obese；错误在于把 < 当成 <=。

notes.t: one value per region plus boundaries

code.out:
-5 Error
15 Underweight
18.5 Normal
20 Normal
23 Overweight
24 Overweight
25 Obese
30 Obese

cards.t: Test data with several inputs: combinations
cards.tz: 多个输入的测试数据：组合
cards.en:
Two dials, each with several settings: to be sure, try every setting of one dial with every setting of the other.

More than one input? Test every combination of their representative values.

  • coupon: 0 (invalid), 1, 2, 3 → 4 values
  • isStudent: True, False → 2 values
  • Test sets = 4 × 2 = 8

A tree diagram helps list them. Missing one (e.g. coupon 1, not a student) can hide a bug in an AND condition.

Exam wording: test all combinations of the representative values of each input; number of test sets = product of the numbers of values.
cards.zh:
两个旋钮各有几个档位：要测得完整，就把每个档位和另一个旋钮的每个档位配对。

有多个输入？要测各代表值的所有组合。

  • coupon：0（无效）、1、2、3 → 4 个
  • isStudent：True、False → 2 个
  • 组数 = 4 × 2 = 8

可画树形图列出。漏掉一组（如 coupon=1 且非学生）可能漏掉 AND 条件的错误。

考试写法：测试各输入代表值的所有组合；组数 = 各输入值个数相乘。

ex.q: An algorithm takes size (S, M, L, invalid X) and member (True/False). How many test combinations?
ex.a: 4 representative sizes × 2 member values = 8 combinations, e.g. (S,True),(S,False),(M,True)...(X,False).

ex.q: Inputs: day type (weekday, weekend), member (yes, no), age group (child, adult, senior). How many combinations?
ex.a:
1. Count each: 2, 2, 3.
2. Multiply: 2 × 2 × 3 = 12.

ex.q: For coupon (0,1,2,3) and isStudent (T,F) a student writes 4 + 2 = 6 test sets. Correct?
ex.a:
1. No. Each coupon value must pair with each student value.
2. Multiply, not add: 4 × 2 = 8.
ex.az: 不对，要相乘不是相加：4×2=8。

notes.tz: 与每个 isStudent 值配对

code.out:
0 True
0 False
1 True
1 False
2 True
2 False
3 True
3 False

cards.t: Choosing the most appropriate test set
cards.tz: 选择最合适的测试数据组
cards.en:
Picking the best test set is like picking a balanced team: you need someone for each position (below range, edges, middle, above range).

MC asks: which set is “most appropriate”? Tick three boxes:

  1. erroneous values on each invalid side
  2. boundary values at each dividing value
  3. normal values for each branch
RuleBest set
second < 0 or > 59 → Error-2, 0, 20, 59, 60
transfer $1 to $30000, 1, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000

Exam wording: the set should include normal, boundary and erroneous data values.
cards.zh:
选最佳测试组像选一支平衡的球队：每个位置都要有人（范围下方、边界、中间、范围上方）。

MC 问“最合适的测试组”？检查三项：

  1. 两边的错误值
  2. 每个分界的边界值
  3. 每个分支的正常值
规则最佳
second < 0 或 > 59 → Error-2, 0, 20, 59, 60
转账 $1-$30000, 1, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000

考试写法：该组应包括 normal、boundary 和 erroneous data values。

ex.q: Algorithm: if op > 5 'smaller', else if op < -5 'larger', else 'OK'. Best set: A -10,-5,0,5,10  B -5,0,5  C -5,5  D -10,10?
ex.a: A. It tests both outer branches (-10, 10), both boundaries (-5, 5) and the middle branch (0). B and C miss the outer branches; D misses the OK branch and boundaries.
ex.az: 选 A：三个分支和两个边界都覆盖。

ex.q: Valid minute 0 to 59. Which is best: A 0,30,59  B -1,0,30,59,60  C -1,60?
ex.a:
1. A has no erroneous data.
2. C has no normal or valid boundaries.
3. B has all three kinds → B.
ex.az: B 三类数据都有。

ex.q: A student picks 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 for a 1 to 100 range because 'more values is better'. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Quantity is not quality.
2. All are normal; 100, 0 and 101 are never tested.
3. Better: 0, 1, 50, 100, 101.
ex.az: 数量多不代表好：全是正常值，没测 0、100、101。

cards.en:
A syntax error is like a sentence with bad grammar: the reader (the interpreter) stops and refuses to go on.

Syntax error = code that breaks the language rules. It cannot be compiled/interpreted or run.

Typical causes:

  • missing colon :
  • misspelt keyword (pirnt)
  • wrong case (Print)
  • missing indent, bracket or quote

The IDE (the program-writing app) usually finds them and shows an error message, e.g. SyntaxError: invalid syntax. Easiest type to find.

Exam wording: a syntax error breaks the rules of the programming language, so the program cannot be executed; it is detected by the IDE/translator with an error message.
cards.zh:
语法错误就像文法错误的句子：读者（解释器）看不懂，拒绝继续。

Syntax error（语法错误）= 违反语言规则，不能编译/执行。

常见原因：漏冒号、关键字拼错（pirnt）、大小写错（Print）、漏缩进/括号/引号。

IDE（写程序的软件）通常能找到并显示错误信息，如 SyntaxError: invalid syntax。最容易发现。

考试写法：Syntax error violates the rules of the programming language; the program cannot be executed; it is detected by the translator/IDE.

ex.q: Explain the error in print"I Love ICT".
ex.a: Syntax error: brackets are missing. Correct: print("I Love ICT").
ex.az: 语法错误：缺少括号。

ex.q: Find the error: if x > 5 (next line print(x) indented).
ex.a:
1. The if line needs a colon.
2. Fix: if x > 5:.
ex.az: if 后漏冒号。

ex.q: A program prints the wrong total but no error message. A student calls it a syntax error. Right?
ex.a:
1. No. With a syntax error the program cannot run at all.
2. It ran and gave a wrong answer → logic error.
ex.az: 不对，能运行但结果错是逻辑错误。

ex.q: What message does print("Hi" give?
ex.a:
1. Python cannot find the closing bracket.
2. Output: SyntaxError ('(' was never closed).
3. Fix: print("Hi").
ex.az: 缺右括号，SyntaxError。

code.src: print("I Love ICT")

notes.tz: 正确：字符串放在括号内

demo.src: print"I Love ICT"

cards.tz: 常见语法/名称错误例子（Python）
cards.en:
Most beginner errors fall into a few families: quotes, brackets, colons, case, names, operators. Learn the list and you will spot them fast.

WrongProblem
print(Welcome Home)string needs quotes
print("No error"missing )
Print(...)case-sensitive
"score" = 98variable name has no quotes
NAME=...; print(name)names are case-sensitive (NameError)
temp = A + 1A used before assignment
if = "5**"if is a reserved keyword
A x Bmultiply is *
fullname - " Tai Man"cannot subtract strings
("10"+"15")/2convert with int() first
math.sqrt, random.uniformimport first
if num < 0missing colon
if num = 0:compare with ==
else body not indentedmissing indent

Some are strictly NameError/TypeError at run time, but all come from breaking the writing rules.

Exam wording: name the error and the fix, e.g. 'Python is case-sensitive; Print should be print.'
cards.zh:
初学者的错误大多属于几类：引号、括号、冒号、大小写、变量名、运算符。记住这张表就能快速找出。

错误写法问题
print(Welcome Home)字符串要加引号
print("No error"漏 )
Print区分大小写
"score" = 98变量名不加引号
NAME / name变量名大小写不同（NameError）
temp = A + 1A 未赋值
if = "5**"if 是关键字
A x B乘号是 *
fullname - "..."字符串不能相减
("10"+"15")/2先 int()
math / random先 import
if num < 0漏冒号
if num = 0:比较用 ==
else 下无缩进漏缩进

有些严格来说是运行时的 NameError/TypeError，但都源于写法不合规则。

考试写法：说出错误和改法，例如 'Python is case-sensitive; Print should be print.'

ex.q:
Find and fix the errors: 
c = math.sqrt(25)
import math
print(c)
ex.a: math is used before it is imported, so Python raises NameError: name 'math' is not defined. Fix: put import math on the first line.
ex.az: math 在 import 之前就被使用。把 import math 移到第一行。

ex.q: Fix C = A x B.
ex.a:
1. x is not an operator in Python.
2. Use C = A * B.
ex.az: 乘号要用 *。

ex.q: Fix total = ("10" + "15")/2. A student says it gives 12.5.
ex.a:
1. "10" + "15" joins strings: "1015".
2. Dividing a string gives TypeError.
3. Fix: (int("10") + int("15"))/2 → 12.5.
ex.az: 字符串相加是连接成 "1015"，再除会 TypeError；要先 int()。

code.src:
import math
NAME = "Apple"
print(NAME)
print(math.sqrt(25))
print((int("10") + int("15")) / 2)

demo.src:
NAME = "Apple"
print(name)

cards.en:
A logic error is like a GPS that drives smoothly to the wrong place: no warning, just the wrong result.

Logic error:

  • no error message, the program still runs;
  • but the logical flow is wrong, so it gives wrong results.

Examples:

  • wrong sequence of statements (swap without temp)
  • wrong condition / control structure (wrong operator, OR for AND, wrong if order)
  • infinite loop (loop variable never updated)

Found only by testing with test data (compare with expected results), dry runs or trace tables. Most debugging time goes here.

Exam wording: a logic error gives no error message; the program runs but produces wrong results due to incorrect logical flow. It is found by testing with test data / dry run.
cards.zh:
逻辑错误像导航顺利地带你去错的地方：没有警告，只是结果错。

Logic error（逻辑错误）：没有错误信息，程序照常运行，但逻辑流程错，结果错。

例子：语句次序错（不用 temp 交换）；条件/控制结构错（运算符、OR/AND、if 次序）；无限循环（循环变量没更新）。

只能靠测试数据比较预期结果、dry run 或 trace table 找出。除错大部分时间花在这里。

考试写法：No error message; the program runs but produces incorrect results; found by testing / dry run.

ex.q:
i <- 1
while i <= 10
    Output i
Purpose: print 1 to 10. Test result, cause, correction?
ex.a: Test result: 1 1 1 1 ... forever. Cause: i is not updated in the loop, resulting in an infinite loop. Correction: add i <- i + 1 inside the loop.
ex.az: i 没有在循环中更新，造成无限循环；在循环内加 i ← i + 1。

ex.q: Average of a and b written a + b / 2. a=4, b=6. Result and fix?
ex.a:
1. Division first: 6/2 = 3, then 4 + 3 = 7.
2. Expected 5 → logic error.
3. Fix: (a + b) / 2.
ex.az: 先除后加得 7，应为 5；加括号。

ex.q: A student says 'my program has no error message, so it is correct.' Reply.
ex.a:
1. Logic errors never show messages.
2. Compare test results with expected results to be sure.
ex.az: 逻辑错误不会显示信息，要比较测试结果和预期结果。

code.src:
i = 1
while i <= 10:
    print(i, end=" ")
    i = i + 1

notes.t: update i: without this line the loop is infinite
notes.tz: 更新 i：漏了就无限循环

demo.src:
i = 1
while i <= 3:
    print(i, end=" ")
    i = i + 1

cards.tz: “永远成立”的条件：OR 与 AND
cards.en:
OR is generous (one side true is enough); AND is strict (both sides must be true). A range like 'between 18 and 65' needs both, so AND.

For a range, use AND.

CodeProblemFix
age >= 18 OR age < 65always True: every age is ≥18 or <65, so everyone gets an Adult ticketage >= 18 AND age < 65
num < 0 AND num > 100always False: no number is both, nothing rejectednum < 1 OR num > 100

Inside a range → AND. Outside a range → OR.

Exam wording: the condition is always True / always False, so it is a logic error; change OR to AND (or AND to OR).
cards.zh:
OR 很宽松（一边成立就行），AND 很严格（两边都要成立）。“介于 18 和 65 之间”要两边都成立，所以用 AND。

表示范围用 AND。

代码问题改正
age >= 18 OR age < 65永远成立，所有人买成人票age >= 18 AND age < 65
num < 0 AND num > 100永远不成立，不会拒绝任何值num < 1 OR num > 100

范围内 → AND；范围外 → OR。

考试写法：该条件永远成立 / 永远不成立，属逻辑错误；把 OR 改为 AND（或相反）。

ex.q: Validation: while num < 0 AND num > 100 ... Test data -5, 0, 150. What happens and how to fix?
ex.a: The condition is always False, so every input (even -5, 150) gives 'Correct input'. Also 0 should be wrong for range 1 to 100. Fix: while num < 1 OR num > 100.
ex.az: 条件永远为假，全部被当作正确；改为 num < 1 OR num > 100。

ex.q: Evaluate age >= 18 or age < 65 for age 10 and 80.
ex.a:
1. age 10: 10 >= 18 F, 10 < 65 T → True.
2. age 80: 80 >= 18 T → True.
3. Both True: always True, a logic error.
ex.az: 10 和 80 都是 True，条件永远成立。

ex.q: To reject numbers outside 1 to 100 a student writes num < 1 and num > 100. Why wrong?
ex.a:
1. No number is both < 1 and > 100.
2. So it is always False; nothing is rejected.
3. Fix: num < 1 or num > 100.
ex.az: 没有数同时 <1 且 >100，永远为假；改用 or。

code.src:
for age in [10, 30, 80]:
    print(age, age >= 18 or age < 65, age >= 18 and age < 65)

notes.t: OR version is always True; AND version is correct
notes.tz: OR 版永远为真；AND 版正确

code.out:
10 True False
30 True True
80 True False

demo.src:
for age in [10, 30, 80]:
    print(age, age >= 18 or age < 65, age >= 18 and age < 65)

cards.tz: 次序错误：交换两个变量
cards.en:
Swapping two cups of drinks needs a third empty cup. Pour one into the empty cup first, or you lose it.

Order of statements matters.

Wrong swap:

  • A ← B → A is now 20
  • B ← A → B is also 20
  • Output 20, 20 (expected 20, 10)

Right swap uses a temporary variable:

temp ← A
A ← B
B ← temp

Python shortcut: A, B = B, A.

Exam wording: wrong sequence of statements; the value of A is overwritten before it is copied. Use a temporary variable.
cards.zh:
交换两杯饮料要用第三个空杯，先倒一杯进空杯，否则就会弄丢。

语句次序很重要。

错误交换：A ← B 后 A=20；B ← A 后 B 也是 20；输出 20, 20（应为 20, 10）。

正确做法用临时变量：

temp ← A
A ← B
B ← temp

Python 也可写 A, B = B, A。

考试写法：语句次序错误，A 的值在复制前被覆盖；应使用临时变量。

ex.q: Trace the wrong swap with A=10, B=20.
ex.a: A <- B gives A=20; B <- A gives B=20. Output 20, 20. Expected 20, 10, so a logic error.

ex.q: Trace the temp swap with A=10, B=20.
ex.a:
1. temp = 10.
2. A = 20.
3. B = temp = 10.
4. Output 20 10 ✔.

ex.q: A student writes A = B then B = A. Output for A=10, B=20?
ex.a:
1. A = B → A = 20.
2. B = A → B = 20.
3. Output 20 20, value 10 lost → logic error (wrong sequence).
ex.az: 输出 20 20，10 丢失，次序错误。

code.src:
A = 10
B = 20
temp = A
A = B
B = temp
print(A, B)

notes.tz: 原来的 A 放入 B

demo.src:
A = 10
B = 20
temp = A
A = B
B = temp
print(A, B)

cards.t: Wrong order of conditions and shifting arrays
cards.tz: 条件次序错误与数组移位
cards.en:
Sorting mail: check the most specific label first. If you check 'any letter' first, the express ones get mixed in.

1. Order of if / else if

  • Wrong: check >= 50 first → 70 and 90 both print Pass.
  • Right: strictest first: >=80 Distinction, >=60 Credit, >=50 Pass, else Fail.

2. Inserting at the front of an array

  • Wrong: for i from 1 to L-1: A[i+1] ← A[i] copies A[1] everywhere.
  • Right: shift from the end backwards: for i from L-1 down to 1: A[i+1] ← A[i], then A[1] ← 170.

Exam wording: the conditions are in the wrong order; check the most restrictive condition first. For shifting: shift from the last element backwards.
cards.zh:
分信件时先看最特别的标签；如果先看“任何信件”，特快件就会混进去。

1. if / else if 次序：先判断 >=50 的话，70、90 都是 Pass。应最严格的先判断：>=80、>=60、>=50，否则 Fail。

2. 在数组开头插入：从前往后 A[i+1] ← A[i] 会把 A[1] 复制到所有位置。要从后往前：for i from L-1 down to 1，再 A[1] ← 170。

考试写法：条件次序错误，应先判断最严格的条件。移位：从最后一个元素往前移。

ex.q: A = [5, 8, 9], insert 170 at front using the forward loop. Result?
ex.az: 从前往后覆盖，结果 [170,5,5,5]，错误。

ex.q: With the corrected order, what does 70 give?
ex.az: 70 不 >=80，>=60 成立，Credit。

ex.q: Wrong order (>=50 first). What do 70 and 90 give?
ex.a:
1. 70 >= 50 True → Pass (should be Credit).
2. 90 >= 50 True → Pass (should be Distinction).
3. Later branches never reached.
ex.az: 都输出 Pass，后面的分支永远到不了。

ex.q: Insert 170 at the front of [5, 8, 9] correctly (shift backwards).

code.src:
A = [5, 8, 9]
A.append(0)
for i in range(len(A) - 2, -1, -1):
    A[i + 1] = A[i]
A[0] = 170
print(A)

notes.t: from the last old item backwards
notes.tz: 从最后一个旧元素往前

notes.t: shift each item one place right
put new item at the front

cards.en:
A run-time error is like a car that starts fine but breaks down on the road when it hits a pothole (bad data).

Run-time error = a problem during execution that makes the program stop unexpectedly. The IDE shows the message after it stops.

CausePython message
divide by zeroZeroDivisionError
square root of a negativeValueError: math domain error
index outside the arrayIndexError: list index out of range
bad input type, int("A")ValueError: invalid literal for int()

The syntax is fine and some data work. It depends on the data, so you need erroneous and boundary test data.

Exam wording: a run-time error occurs during execution and causes the program to terminate unexpectedly, e.g. division by zero, array index out of range.
cards.zh:
运行时错误像车子能发动，但在路上碰到坑洞（某些数据）就抛锚。

Run-time error（运行时错误）= 执行中出问题，令程序意外终止；中止后 IDE 显示信息。

原因信息
除以零ZeroDivisionError
负数开方ValueError: math domain error
索引越界IndexError
int("A")ValueError: invalid literal for int()

语法正确，部分数据也能运行；视乎数据，所以要用错误和边界测试数据。

考试写法：Run-time error occurs during execution and leads to unexpected termination, e.g. division by zero, index out of range.

ex.q:
AR = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
for i in range(0, 6):
    print(AR[i])
What happens?
ex.a: Prints 2 4 6 8 10, then when i = 5 AR[5] is outside indices 0 to 4: IndexError: list index out of range, program terminates. Fix: range(0, 5) or range(len(AR)).
ex.az: i=5 时越界，IndexError；改成 range(len(AR))。

ex.q: x = int(input()) then print(10 / x). Input 0?
ex.a:
1. Program starts and reads 0.
2. 10 / 0 is impossible.
3. ZeroDivisionError, the program stops.
ex.az: 输入 0 时除以零，程序中止。

ex.q: A student says the IndexError loop is a syntax error because there is an error message. Correct?
ex.a:
1. No. The code ran and printed 2 4 6 8 10 first.
2. It stopped only when i = 5 → run-time error.
ex.az: 不对，程序已运行并输出，之后才中止，是运行时错误。

code.out:
2
4
6
8
10
IndexError: list index out of range

cards.tz: 读懂 Python 错误信息
cards.en:
An error message is a note from Python telling you where it got stuck and why. Read the bottom line first.

A Traceback (Python's error report) shows:

  • the file and line number
  • the line that failed
  • on the last line: error type + message. Read this first.
MessageMeaning
SyntaxError: invalid syntaxbreaks language rules
NameError: name 'x' is not definedmisspelt/undefined name, or module not imported
ZeroDivisionErrordivisor is 0
ValueError: math domain errore.g. sqrt of a negative
ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'A'cannot convert input
IndexError: list index out of rangeindex beyond the list
TypeErrorwrong type, e.g. str + int

Exam wording: name the error type and cause, e.g. 'ZeroDivisionError: division by zero, a run-time error because X - Y = 0.'
cards.zh:
错误信息是 Python 留给你的字条：在哪里卡住、为什么。先读最后一行。

Traceback（Python 的错误报告）显示：文件和行号、出错的行、最后一行的错误类型和信息（先读这行）。

信息意思
SyntaxError违反语法
NameError名称拼错/未定义/未 import
ZeroDivisionError除以零
ValueError: math domain error负数开方
ValueError: invalid literal for int()输入不能转整数
IndexError索引越界
TypeError类型不符，如字符串加整数

考试写法：写出错误类型和原因，例如 'ZeroDivisionError, run-time error because X - Y = 0.'

ex.q: X = 2, Y = 2, Z = (X + Y)/(X - Y). Error?
ex.a: X - Y = 0, so ZeroDivisionError: division by zero on line 3, a run-time error.
ex.az: X-Y=0，除以零，运行时错误。

ex.q: What does int("A") give?
ex.a:
1. "A" is not a number.
2. ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'A'.
ex.az: "A" 不能转整数，ValueError。

ex.q: A student sees NameError: name 'math' is not defined and renames a variable. Better fix?
ex.a:
1. NameError for a module means it was not imported.
2. Add import math at the top.
ex.az: 这是没 import math，应加 import。

ex.q: "Age: " + 16?
ex.a:
1. Cannot add str and int.
2. TypeError. Fix: "Age: " + str(16).
ex.az: 字符串加整数是 TypeError，要 str()。

code.src:
X = 2
Y = 2
Z = (X + Y) / (X - Y)
print(Z)

demo.src: print(int("A"))

cards.en:
Three kinds of trouble: can't start (syntax), breaks down on the way (run-time), arrives at the wrong place (logic).

SyntaxRun-timeLogic
Runs?NoStarts, then stopsYes, to the end
Message?Yes, before runningYes, after stoppingNo
Causebreaks rulesimpossible operation with some datawrong logical flow
Found byIDE / translatorerroneous / boundary test datatest data, dry run, trace table, debug mode

Exam wording: cannot run → syntax error; stops with message → run-time error; wrong output, no message → logic error.
cards.zh:
三种麻烦：开不了车（语法）、半路抛锚（运行时）、到错地方（逻辑）。

语法运行时逻辑
能运行？不能开始后中止能运行完
错误信息？有，运行前有，中止后没有
原因违反规则某些数据下操作不可能逻辑流程错
找出方法IDE / 翻译程序错误/边界测试数据测试数据、dry run、trace table、debug mode

考试写法：不能运行→syntax；中途停止有信息→run-time；输出错误无信息→logic。

ex.q:
import math
A = int("10")
B = 2
C = math.sqrt(-A + B)
Which error type(s)?
ex.a: -A + B = -8, sqrt of a negative number raises ValueError while running: run-time error only. The syntax is valid.
ex.az: -10+2=-8，负数开方，只有运行时错误。

ex.q: print(5 * 3 = 15) wants to print 15. Error type?
ex.a:
1. = cannot be used inside like that; Python refuses to run.
2. Syntax error.
ex.az: 不能运行，语法错误。

ex.q: Area of a circle written 3.14 * r * 2. Error type?
ex.a:
1. Runs fine, no message.
2. r=1 gives 6.28 not 3.14.
3. Logic error. Fix: r * r.
ex.az: 能运行但结果错，逻辑错误。

ex.q: A student says the sqrt(-8) example has a syntax error AND a run-time error. Right?
ex.a:
1. The syntax is all valid.
2. It fails only while running → run-time error only.
ex.az: 语法都正确，只有运行时错误。

code.src:
import math
A = int("10")
B = 2
C = math.sqrt(-A + B)

demo.src:
import math
A = int("10")
B = 2
C = math.sqrt(-A + B)

cards.en:
Fixing a syntax error is like proofreading: go to the line the checker points at, then look just before it too.

Steps:

  1. Run. The IDE stops and points at a line (often with ^).
  2. Read the error message.
  3. Check the line against the rules:
    • colon after if / else / for / while / def
    • brackets and quotes in pairs
    • correct case: print, input
    • indentation
    • valid names (not keywords, no quotes)
    • right operators: *, ==
  4. Fix and run again.

Note: the reported line can be after the real mistake (e.g. a bracket missing on the line before).

Exam wording: read the error message and line number, compare with the correct syntax, correct it and run again.
cards.zh:
改语法错误像校对：到提示的那行看，也要看它的上一行。

步骤：

  1. 运行，IDE 停在出错行（常有 ^）。
  2. 读错误信息。
  3. 对照规则：if/else/for/while/def 后冒号；括号引号配对；大小写（print、input）；缩进；变量名合法；运算符（*、==）。
  4. 修改后再运行。

注意：报错行可能在真正错误的下一行。

考试写法：阅读错误信息和行号，对照正确语法修改，再运行。

ex.q: Fix: word = input(input word:)
ex.a: The prompt must be a string: word = input("input word:").
ex.az: 提示文字要加引号。

ex.q: Fix if num = 0:.
ex.a:
1. = assigns, == compares.
2. if num == 0:.
ex.az: 比较要用 ==。

ex.q: Error points at line 3, but line 3 print(x) looks fine; line 2 is x = (5 + 2. A student keeps editing line 3. What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Python reports where it noticed the problem.
2. The missing bracket is on line 2.
3. Fix line 2: x = (5 + 2).
ex.az: 真正的错误在上一行（漏括号），要改第 2 行。

demo.src:
if 3 > 2
    print("yes")

cards.t: Debugging logic errors with test data
cards.tz: 用测试数据调试逻辑错误
cards.en:
Like a doctor: compare symptoms (test results) with what is healthy (expected), then trace back to the cause.

The book's table:

Purpose → Pseudocode → Testing (test data, expected result, test result) → Cause of error → Correction

  1. Run each test datum and record the real output.
  2. Where test result ≠ expected result, follow that path.
  3. Find the bad condition, sequence or loop.
  4. Correct it.
  5. Re-test with the same data.

Exam wording: test result differs from expected result; cause: ...; correction: ..., then re-test with the same test data.
cards.zh:
像医生看病：把症状（测试结果）和健康状态（预期）比较，再追查原因。

课本表格：目的 → 伪代码 → 测试（数据、预期、结果）→ 错误原因 → 更正

  1. 逐个代入测试数据，记下实际输出。
  2. 结果和预期不同，就沿那条路径追查。
  3. 找出错的条件、次序或循环。
  4. 更正。
  5. 用同样数据再测试。

考试写法：测试结果与预期不同；原因：…；更正：…，然后用同样数据再测试。

ex.q: Grade program tested with 40, 55, 70, 90 gives Fail, Pass, Pass, Pass. Expected Fail, Pass, Credit, Distinction. Cause?
ex.a: 70 and 90 give wrong results. Because score >= 50 is checked first, every score ≥ 50 outputs Pass and later branches are never reached. Correction: test >=80, then >=60, then >=50.
ex.az: 70、90 结果错：先判断 >=50 截住了所有高分，要把条件次序反过来。

ex.q: Sum 1..5 code: total=0; for i in range(1,5): total+=i prints 10. Debug.
ex.a:
1. Expected 15, got 10 → logic error.
2. range(1,5) gives 1-4, missing 5.
3. Fix: range(1, 6). Re-test → 15.
ex.az: 预期 15 得 10；range 少了 5，改 range(1,6)。

ex.q: After fixing one bug, a student only tests the new value. Problem?
ex.a:
1. The fix may break other paths.
2. Re-run the whole test table.
ex.az: 修好后要用全部测试数据再测，因为修改可能弄坏其他路径。

code.src:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    total = total + i
print(total)

demo.src:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    total = total + i
print(total)

cards.en:
Debug mode is a slow-motion replay: run one line at a time and watch each variable change.

Besides hand dry runs and trace tables, the IDE's debug mode shows the flow and each variable step by step.

In Thonny:

  1. Write the program.
  2. Click View.
  3. Tick Variables.
  4. Click the bug icon Debug current script.
  5. Click Step into (F7) to run the next command and see current values.
  6. Keep stepping.

You see which if branch runs and when a variable changes. Good for logic errors.

Exam wording: debug mode lets the programmer execute the program step by step and check the value of each variable.
cards.zh:
除错模式就像慢镜头重播：一次执行一行，看着每个变量怎样变化。

除了人手 dry run 和 trace table，IDE 的 debug mode 可逐步显示流程和变量值。

Thonny：

  1. 写程序
  2. 按 View
  3. 勾 Variables
  4. 按虫子 Debug current script
  5. 按 Step into (F7) 执行下一条并看变量
  6. 继续逐步

能看到 if 走哪个分支、变量何时变化，适合找逻辑错误。

考试写法：Debug mode lets the programmer execute step by step and check the value of each variable.

ex.q: Program: A=1, B=3, if A>B print(B-A/2) else print(A-B/2). What will stepping show?
ex.a: Variables window: A=1, then B=3. Condition A>B evaluates False, so the else branch runs and prints 1 - 1.5 = -0.5.
ex.az: A=1、B=3，A>B 为假，走 else，输出 -0.5。

ex.q: Which Thonny button runs just the next statement?
ex.a:
1. After clicking Debug current script,
2. use Step into (F7).
ex.az: 按 Step into (F7)。

ex.q: A student runs the program normally (green Run) and expects the Variables window to step line by line. What went wrong?
ex.a:
1. Normal Run executes everything at once.
2. Use the bug icon Debug current script, then F7.
ex.az: 普通运行会一次跑完，要按虫子图标再 F7。

ex.q: In the A=1, B=3 program, which line runs after the condition?
ex.a:
1. A > B is 1 > 3 → False.
2. Jump to else; print(A - B / 2) → -0.5.
ex.az: 条件为假，执行 else，输出 -0.5。

cards.en:
Building a program is like building a house: first plan (analysis), then build and inspect (implementation), then hand over the manual (documentation).

Two main stages:

(1) Problem analysis stage

  1. Define the problem.
  2. Identify inputs and outputs.
  3. Design the algorithm.

(2) Implementation stage

  1. Write the program.
  2. 5.1 Run it → find syntax errors.
    5.2 Test with test data → find run-time and logic errors.
  3. Documentation.

Fig 6.1 loops: run fails → fix → write again; test fails → fix → write again; both OK → documentation.

Exam wording: problem analysis stage (define problem, identify inputs/outputs, design algorithm); implementation stage (write program, run to remove syntax errors, test with test data for run-time/logic errors, documentation).
cards.zh:
写程序像盖房子：先规划（分析），再建造和检查（实施），最后交说明书（文档）。

两个阶段：

(1) Problem analysis stage：1 定义问题；2 确定输入输出；3 设计算法。

(2) Implementation stage：4 写程序；5.1 运行找语法错误；5.2 用测试数据找运行时和逻辑错误；6 文档。

图 6.1 是循环：失败就回去改，都通过才写文档。

考试写法：problem analysis stage 和 implementation stage，按步骤写出。

ex.q: A programmer finished a profit-calculation program. What should he do next?
ex.a: Use different sets of test data to test for any possible errors (stage 5.2), before documentation and delivery. Determining inputs/outputs and drawing flowcharts belong to earlier stages.
ex.az: 下一步用不同测试数据测试，找出可能的错误。

ex.q: Put in order: test with test data, define problem, documentation, design algorithm, write program.
ex.a:
1. Define problem
2. Design algorithm
3. Write program
4. Test with test data
5. Documentation
ex.az: 定义问题→设计算法→写程序→测试→文档。

ex.q: A student writes documentation right after the program first runs without syntax errors. Problem?
ex.a:
1. No syntax errors does not mean correct.
2. Must test with test data for run-time and logic errors first.
ex.az: 没有语法错误不等于正确，要先用测试数据测试。

frames.en: List what goes in and comes out.
Fix syntax errors, back to step 4.
frames.zh: 修语法错误，回到第 4 步。

frames.en: Use test data, fix run-time / logic errors.
frames.zh: 用测试数据找运行时/逻辑错误。

frames.en: Write it up when all tests pass.

cards.en:
Two routes to school can both get you there; the better one takes fewer steps and uses less (money, energy). Algorithms are compared the same way.

Compare algorithms by:

  • steps of operation: how many comparisons/evaluations (time)
  • resource usage: e.g. number of variables, memory

Fewer steps + less resource = more efficient.

One step is tiny in a small program but big in a loop (100 vs 1,000,000 runs).

Tricks from the book:

  • nested / else-if conditions to cut evaluations
  • a while loop that stops once the answer is found

Exam wording: compare algorithms by steps of operation and resource usage; the one with fewer steps and less resource usage is more efficient.
cards.zh:
两条上学路线都能到；更好的那条步骤少、花费少。算法也这样比较。

比较算法看：steps of operation（运算步骤）和 resource usage（资源，如变量、内存）。步骤少、资源少 = 更有效率。

小程序差一步无所谓，循环里就差很多。

方法：用嵌套 / else if 减少判断；用找到即停的 while 循环。

考试写法：以 steps of operation 和 resource usage 比较；步骤少、资源少者更有效率。

ex.q: Algorithm 1: two separate ifs (mark>=50 Pass; mark<50 Fail). Algorithm 2: if/else. Compare.
ex.a: Algorithm 1 always makes 2 comparisons; Algorithm 2 makes 1. Algorithm 2 is more efficient (fewer steps), same result.
ex.az: 算法1 比较 2 次，算法2 只比较 1 次，算法2 更有效率。

ex.q: Algorithm X: 3 variables, 100 steps. Y: 3 variables, 60 steps. Which is better?
ex.a:
1. Same resources.
2. Y has fewer steps → Y is more efficient.
ex.az: 资源相同，Y 步骤少，更有效率。

ex.q: A student says 'one extra comparison never matters'. Reply.
ex.a:
1. In a loop run 1,000,000 times, one extra comparison is 1,000,000 extra steps.
2. So it matters in large programs.
ex.az: 在循环中多一次比较就是多一百万步，大程序里很重要。

notes.tz: 3 次（两个 if 要 6 次）

cards.en:
Best case is when the thing you want is on top of the pile; worst case is when it is at the bottom or not there at all.

  • Best case: the input that needs the fewest steps.
  • Worst case: the input that needs the most steps.
Greeting algorithmEvaluations
Alg 1: five separate ifsalways 5
Alg 2: else-if chain1 for time 300 (best), 4 for 1900, 2200 (worst)

Alg 2 is never worse → more efficient.

Linear search with stop flag: best = target at A[1] (1); worst = target at A[N] or absent (N).

Exam wording: best case: fewest steps of operation; worst case: most steps of operation.
cards.zh:
最好情况是要找的东西在最上面；最差情况是在最底或根本不在。

  • Best case：步骤最少的输入。
  • Worst case：步骤最多的输入。
问候语算法判断次数
算法1：五个独立 if永远 5
算法2：else if300 只要 1（最好）；1900、2200 要 4（最差）

算法2 从不更差 → 更有效率。

带停止标志的线性搜索：最好 A[1]（1 次）；最差 A[N] 或不存在（N 次）。

考试写法：best case 步骤最少；worst case 步骤最多。

ex.q: Algorithm 2 (else-if): Sleeping (<500 or >=2300), <1200 morning, <1800 afternoon, <2000 evening, else night. Evaluations for time 900 and 2100?
ex.a: 900: condition 1 false, <1200 true → 2 evaluations. 2100: four conditions false, then else → 4 evaluations.

ex.q: Linear search with stop, list [4, 9, 2, 7]. Comparisons for target 4, 7, 5?
ex.a:
1. 4: found at 1st → 1.
2. 7: 4th → 4.
3. 5: not found → 4 (worst case).
ex.az: 4 要 1 次；7 要 4 次；5 不在也要 4 次。

ex.q: A student says the worst case of linear search is only when the target is last. Missing?
ex.a:
1. Target not in the list also needs N comparisons.
2. Both are worst cases.
ex.az: 目标不在列表中也是最差情况。

cards.t: Stopping a loop early (while vs for)
cards.tz: 提早结束循环（while 对 for）
cards.en:
Looking for your keys: once you find them you stop searching. A for loop keeps checking every drawer anyway.

  • for loop over the whole array: always N checks, even if the target is first.
  • while loop with found = False in the condition: exits once found, usually fewer steps.
found ← False
i ← 1
while i <= N and found = False
    if target = A[i]
        found ← True
    i ← i + 1
Output found

Same idea for “is the array sorted?”: stop at the first pair with S[i] > S[i+1].

Exam wording: the while loop exits once the target is found, so fewer steps of operation are needed.
cards.zh:
找钥匙：找到就停。for 循环却会把每个抽屉都翻一遍。

  • for 循环：永远检查 N 个，即使目标在第一个。
  • while 循环加 found = False 条件：找到即退出，通常步骤更少。
found ← False
i ← 1
while i <= N and found = False
    if target = A[i]
        found ← True
    i ← i + 1
Output found

检查是否已排序也一样：一发现 S[i] > S[i+1] 就停。

考试写法：while 循环找到目标后即退出，所以运算步骤较少。

ex.q: Array has 1000 items, target at A[3]. Evaluations for for-version vs while-version?
ex.a: for-version: 1000 evaluations of target = A[i]. while-version: 3 (stops after finding at i = 3).
ex.az: for 版本 1000 次，while 版本 3 次。

ex.q: Check if [1, 3, 2, 5, 6] is sorted with the early-stop loop. How many comparisons?
ex.a:
1. 1>3? no (1).
2. 3>2? yes (2) → not sorted, stop.
3. 2 comparisons.
ex.az: 第 2 次比较发现 3>2，停止，共 2 次。

ex.q: A student writes the while condition as i <= N or found == False. What happens if the target is missing?
ex.a:
1. When i passes N, found is still False, so OR stays True.
2. A[i] goes out of range → run-time error (or infinite loop).
3. Must be and.
ex.az: 用 or 会越界或无限循环，要用 and。

code.src:
A = [7, 3, 9, 4]
target = 3
found = False
i = 0
while i < len(A) and found == False:
    if A[i] == target:
        found = True
    i = i + 1
print(found, i)

notes.t: stop at end OR when found

demo.src:
A = [7, 3, 9, 4]
target = 3
found = False
i = 0
while i < len(A) and found == False:
    if A[i] == target:
        found = True
    i = i + 1
print(found, i)

cards.tz: 找最小值：减少比较次数
cards.en:
Finding the shortest person: keep a 'record holder' and compare each new person once with the record, not with everyone.

Example 6.2 Q3: lightest of 3 students.

MethodComparisons
Alg 1keep a “lightest record”, compare each once3 (about N)
Alg 2compare every pair with Boolean flags3×3+3 = 12 (about N²)

Alg 1 is more efficient. For N students:

lightest ← AR[1]
student ← 1
for i from 2 to N
    if AR[i] < lightest then
        lightest ← AR[i]
        student ← i
Output student, AR[student]

Start the record with the first item, not 0. With positive data, 0 is never beaten (logic error, Checkpoint 6.2).

Exam wording: initialise the minimum with the first element; compare each remaining element once (N-1 comparisons).
cards.zh:
找最矮的人：记住一个“纪录保持者”，每个新人只和纪录比一次，不用和所有人比。

例 6.2 Q3：三人中最轻。

方法比较次数
算法1保存最轻纪录，每人比一次3（约 N）
算法2两两比较加布尔标志12（约 N²）

算法1 更有效率。N 人版本见伪代码（从第 2 个开始循环）。

lightest ← AR[1]
student ← 1
for i from 2 to N
    if AR[i] < lightest then
        lightest ← AR[i]
        student ← i
Output student, AR[student]

纪录要用第一个元素初始化，不能用 0（Checkpoint 6.2 的逻辑错误）。

考试写法：用第一个元素初始化最小值，其余元素各比一次（N-1 次）。

ex.q: Flowchart sets min <- 0 then reads 3 numbers, updating if N < min. Which input set gives a wrong result: (-1,-3,-5), (0,0,0), (-2,0,6), (2,5,6)?
ex.a: With 2, 5, 6 none is < 0, so the output stays 0 instead of 2. Answer: 2, 5, 6. Cause: the initial value of min is 0.
ex.az: 2,5,6 都不小于 0，输出 0，错误；原因是 min 初始值为 0。

ex.q: Trace the loop for [52, 47, 60, 45].
ex.a:
1. lightest=52.
2. 47<52 → 47, student 1.
3. 60 no.
4. 45<47 → 45, student 3.
5. Output 3 45.
ex.az: 最终最轻 45，索引 3。

ex.q: min starts at 0 and data are 2, 5, 6. Output?
ex.a:
1. No value < 0, so min never changes.
2. Output 0, but the answer is 2.
3. Fix: start with the first item.
ex.az: 输出 0 而不是 2；初始值要用第一个元素。

code.src:
AR = [52, 47, 60, 45]
lightest = AR[0]
student = 0
for i in range(1, len(AR)):
    if AR[i] < lightest:
        lightest = AR[i]
        student = i
print(student, lightest)

demo.src:
AR = [52, 47, 60, 45]
lightest = AR[0]
student = 0
for i in range(1, len(AR)):
    if AR[i] < lightest:
        lightest = AR[i]
        student = i
print(student, lightest)

cards.en:
Sometimes you trade time for space: a big backpack (more memory) saves trips, a small one (less memory) needs more trips.

Fewer steps can cost more memory. Adding 5 inputs:

StepsVariablesMerit
Alg 1: num1..num5, total76fewer steps
Alg 2: loop, num, total24 (book counts loop counter)2less resource

In Alg 1 each input variable is used once but keeps taking memory. Alg 2 reuses num.

Data type also matters: found as Boolean = 1 bit, as integer = 32 bits (C++). Boolean saves memory.

Like picking an MTR route (fewer transfers vs shorter time): each choice has merits and demerits.

Exam wording: Algorithm 1 needs fewer steps of operation; Algorithm 2 uses fewer variables (less resource usage).
cards.zh:
有时要在时间和空间之间取舍：大背包（多内存）少跑几趟，小背包（少内存）多跑几趟。

步骤少可能要多用内存。加 5 个数：

步骤变量优点
算法1：num1..num5、total76步骤少
算法2：循环 num、total242资源少

算法1 的输入变量只用一次却一直占内存；算法2 重用 num。

found 用 Boolean 1 bit，用 integer 32 bits（C++）。

像选港铁路线：各有优缺点。

考试写法：算法1 步骤较少；算法2 变量较少（资源较少）。

ex.q: found is set to True/1 when the target is found. Which data type uses less memory and why?
ex.a: Boolean: needs only 1 bit to store True/False, while an integer needs 32 bits (C++). Both algorithms have the same steps.
ex.az: Boolean 只要 1 bit，整数要 32 bit。

ex.q: Compare: 5 separate variables vs one loop variable for adding 5 numbers.
ex.a:
1. Separate: fewer steps, 6 variables.
2. Loop: more steps (counter), 2 variables.
3. Each has a merit.
ex.az: 分开变量步骤少但变量多；循环变量少但步骤多。

ex.q: A student says 'Algorithm 2 is better in every way because it uses fewer variables.' Correct?
ex.a:
1. No. It needs more steps (loop counter updates and checks).
2. It is a trade-off, not better in every way.
ex.az: 不对，它步骤更多，是取舍。

code.src:
total = 0
for k in range(5):
    num = int(input())
    total = total + num
print(total)

demo.src:
total = 0
for k in range(5):
    num = int(input())
    total = total + num
print(total)

cards.tz: 误解：变量与数组占用的资源
cards.en:
Ten separate boxes or one box with ten slots take about the same shelf space; the slotted box is just easier to carry.

  • Wrong: 10 variables use much more resource than an array of 10 items.
  • Right: they use nearly the same resource.

Real benefits of an array:

  • shorter code (one loop with an index)
  • data is organised and easy to use

Exam wording: 10 variables occupy nearly the same resources as an array of 10 items, but arrays reduce lengthy code and help organise data.
cards.zh:
十个独立盒子和一个十格的盒子占的空间差不多，只是十格盒子更方便。

  • 错：10 个变量比 10 个元素的数组占用多得多资源。
  • 对：两者差不多。

数组的真正好处：代码较短（一个循环加索引）；数据有组织、易用。

考试写法：10 variables occupy nearly the same resources as an array of 10 items; arrays reduce lengthy code.

ex.q: Give one advantage of storing 30 marks in an array instead of 30 variables.
ex.a: The marks can be processed with a loop and index (e.g. for i in range(30)), so code is much shorter and easier to maintain. Memory use is about the same.
ex.az: 可以用循环和索引处理，代码更短更易维护；内存差不多。

ex.q: Find the total of 30 marks with an array.
ex.a:
1. marks = list of 30.
2. total = 0; for m in marks: total += m.
3. Three lines instead of 30 additions.
ex.az: 用循环三行就完成。

ex.q: A student says 'use an array to save memory'. Correct?
ex.a:
1. No. Memory is about the same.
2. The real reason: shorter code, easier to organise.
ex.az: 不对，内存差不多，好处是代码短、易组织。

code.src:
marks = [70, 85, 62]
total = 0
for m in marks:
    total = total + m
print(total)

demo.src:
marks = [70, 85, 62]
total = 0
for m in marks:
    total = total + m
print(total)

cards.t: Equally efficient? Compound vs nested conditions
cards.tz: 效率相同吗？复合条件与嵌套条件
cards.en:
'and' gives up as soon as one side is False, just like a nested if never checks the inner test when the outer fails.

Short-circuit evaluation = Python stops checking and as soon as one side is False.

  • if A == 0 and B == 0:
  • if A == 0: then nested if B == 0:

If A == 0 is False, neither checks B. Steps are nearly the same.

Grade checkComparisons for "5**"
Alg 1: one if with or1
Alg 2: two separate ifs2 (always both)
Alg 3: if / elif1

Alg 1 and 3 equally efficient; Alg 2 less efficient.

Exam wording: due to short-circuit evaluation, the steps of operation are nearly the same.
cards.zh:
and 一发现一边为假就放弃，和嵌套 if 外层不成立就不看内层一样。

Short-circuit evaluation（短路求值）= and 一边为假就停。

if A == 0 and B == 0 与嵌套 if：A 不是 0 时都不会比较 B，步骤差不多。

成绩判断"5**" 比较次数
算法1：or1
算法2：两个 if2
算法3：if/elif1

算法1、3 效率相同；算法2 较差。

考试写法：由于 short-circuit evaluation，两者运算步骤差不多。

ex.q: Which is less efficient for grade = "5**": (1) if ... or ...; (2) two separate ifs; (3) if/elif?
ex.a: (1): 1 comparison (short-circuit). (2): 2 comparisons. (3): 1 comparison. Version (2) is least efficient; (1) and (3) are equally efficient.
ex.az: (2) 要比较 2 次，最差；(1)(3) 都只比 1 次。

ex.q: if A == 0 and B == 0 with A = 3. How many comparisons?
ex.a:
1. A == 0 is False.
2. 'and' stops, B not checked.
3. 1 comparison.
ex.az: A==0 为假，短路，只比较 1 次。

ex.q: A student says 'and' always checks both sides, so the nested if is faster. Correct?
ex.a:
1. No. Python short-circuits.
2. Both make the same comparisons.
ex.az: 不对，Python 有短路求值，两者一样。

notes.tz: 辅助函数显示每次比较

cards.en:
The book ends with a Core Exercise (pp.204–213) mixing Ch4–6. Patterns to know:

  • Vending machine: parallel lists price and stock; if stock[i] > 0: stock[i] = stock[i] - 1, output price, else "out of stock". Writing the pseudocode belongs to the problem analysis stage (design the algorithm).
  • Grades with else-if: boundary cases sit at each dividing value (e.g. 80/81, 65/66, 49/50, 35/36, 20/21); boundary cases are used in the testing step.
  • Fibonacci: num[0] ← 1, num[1] ← 1, then num[i] ← num[i-1] + num[i-2] for i from 2 to 99.
  • Compound interest: A = P * (1 + r/100/n) ** (n*t). If n = 0 → run-time error (ZeroDivisionError). Validation: keep asking while n <= 0.
  • Plane seats: list seat of 500, 0 = empty. Book: check seat[target] == 0. Delete: search for num, set to 0. Switch: target must be empty, then move.
  • Sorted check trap: [5,5,5,5,5] with if array[i-1] < array[i] → still True (equal items do not break descending order).
cards.zh:
书末 Core Exercise（第 204–213 页）综合第 4–6 章。要认得的题型：

  • 自动售卖机：平行列表 price 和 stock；stock[i] > 0 就减 1 并输出价钱，否则 "out of stock"。写伪代码属问题分析阶段。
  • else-if 等级：边界个案在每个分界值两边（80/81、65/66、49/50、35/36、20/21），用于测试步骤。
  • 斐波那契：num[0]=1，num[1]=1，之后 num[i] = num[i-1] + num[i-2]。
  • 复利：A = P*(1+r/100/n)**(n*t)。n = 0 → 运行时错误（除以零）。验证：while n <= 0 重新输入。
  • 飞机座位：seat 有 500 项，0 = 空位。订位要先查 seat[target] == 0；删除要找 num 再设 0；换位要目标空位。
  • 排序陷阱：[5,5,5,5,5] 用 array[i-1] < array[i] 检查，结果仍是 True。

ex.a:

num[0] = 1

for i in range(2, X):
    num[i] = num[i-1] + num[i-2]
for i in range(0, X):
    print(num[i])
X = 6 → 1 1 2 3 5 8.
ex.az: 先设头两项为 1，再逐项相加。

ex.q: Program crashes when input is 0. Which row?
ex.a:
1. It stops while running.
2. Row: run-time error (e.g. 10/0).

ex.q: Wrong output, no message: syntax error?
ex.a: 1. No: that is a logic error.
ex.az: 不是，是逻辑错误。

mc.q: Anson has finished designing an algorithm and tested it with some valid data items. What should he do next?
o: Draw the flowchart for the algorithm.
Improve the algorithm with modularized design.
Continue to test the algorithm with invalid data items.
mc.e: Testing must also include erroneous (invalid) data.

mc.q:
Refer to the algorithm:
Input second
if second < 0 or second > 59 then
    Output "Error"
Which set of test data is the most appropriate?
mc.e: It has erroneous values on both sides (-2, 60), both boundaries (0, 59) and a normal value.
mc.ez: 两边错误值、两个边界和正常值都有。
mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.1 Q2 (p.167)

mc.q: A digital wallet allows transfers from $1 to $3000. Which set of amounts should be used as test data?

mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.1 Q3 (p.167)

mc.q: Algorithm: if X > 50 then Y ← 100 else Y ← 0. Which are the boundary cases? (1) 0 (2) 50 (3) 51 (4) 100

mc.ez: 分界值是 50，所以 50 和 51 是边界。
mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.1 Q4 (p.168)

mc.q: Algorithm: if op > 5 'Should be smaller'; else if op < -5 'Should be larger'; else 'OK'. Most appropriate test data?
mc.e: Covers all three branches and both boundaries.
mc.ez: 覆盖三个分支和两个边界。
mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.1 Q5 (p.168)

mc.q: Slope algorithm: Y2←4, Y1←2, X1←1, Output (Y2-Y1)/(X2-X1). Which input X2 gives a run-time error?

mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.2 Q1 (p.179)

mc.q: A flowchart finds the smallest of three inputs with min ← 0 initially and min ← N whenever N < min. Which set cannot output the correct result?
mc.e: No positive number is below 0, so 0 is output instead of 2.

mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.2 Q2 (p.179)

mc.q: Following the previous question, which logic error prevents the correct result?

The initial value of c is 1.

mc.ez: min 应以第一个输入为初值。
mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.2 Q3 (p.179)

mc.q: Algorithm 1 checks all 100 pairs with a for loop; Algorithm 2 uses while i <= 100 AND sorted_list = True. Which is correct about execution times?
mc.e: Algorithm 2 stops at the first unsorted pair.
mc.ez: 算法2 一发现未排序就停止。
mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.3 Q1 (p.189)

mc.q: BMI Algorithm 1 uses single conditions (bmi < 18.5, < 23, < 25); Algorithm 2 uses compound ones (0 < bmi AND bmi < 18.5, 18.5 <= bmi AND bmi < 23 ...). Steps of operation?
mc.e: Algorithm 2 makes two comparisons per condition; the lower checks are redundant in an else-if chain.
mc.ez: 算法2 每个条件比较两次，多余。
mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch6 Checkpoint 6.3 Q2 (p.189)

mc.q: Algorithm 1: if A == 0 and B == 0. Algorithm 2: nested if A == 0: if B == 0. Steps of operation?
mc.e: Short-circuit 'and' evaluates B only when A == 0, just like the nested version.

mc.e: The book quotes 1 bit.

pr.task: The program should print the integers 1 to 10, one per line, but it never stops. Fix the logic error.
pr.taskz: 程序应逐行打印 1 到 10，但永不停止。修正逻辑错误。
pr.solution:
i = 1
while i <= 10:
